nodes.label: Known limits
nodes.rationale: Forms/links not editable; highlight clips per text run not per char; rotated text undetected; no page insert/merge/reorder, OCR, layers or certified signature.

nodes.rationale: Characters outside Latin-1 become '?' in the saved PDF.
